### What is IgG4-Related Disease

IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) is an immune-mediated condition that can involve nearly any organ in the body. It causes inflammation and symptoms that can mimic other illnesses, which can delay a clear diagnosis and timely, effective treatment.

The condition can cause swelling, lumps, or scarring in different organs, which is why it can resemble infections, cancers, or other autoimmune diseases. This overlap often makes diagnosis challenging. Experts believe IgG4-RD stems from an overactive immune response involving specific immune cells and antibodies. With timely recognition and treatment, many people do well on steroids or targeted therapies that calm the immune system and protect affected tissues.

Misdiagnoses, mistaken cancer diagnoses, unnecessary surgeries, and years of confusion. This is too often the journey of IgG4-RD patients. Dr. Stone knew the time had come to create the only organization solely dedicated to this disease.

# How you can help

### Advocacy at IgG4ward!

At IgG4ward! our advocacy efforts help those impacted by IgG4-RD be seen, heard and supported. To accomplish this we start by guiding you to be your own advocate. Our community has taught us that self-advocacy is often the best form of support when navigating today's healthcare systems. That's why we built a self-guided education hub where you can learn everything there is to know about this disease. We also conduct regular online webinars, we call Fireside chats, where you can learn from and ask questions of expert physicians. Our online community app and in-person events also allow genuine connection and discussion among patients and caregivers living a similar journey. These are to mention only a few advocacy programs.

### Why donate

With your help, we can work together to create a brighter future and make meaningful progress for the IgG4-RD community. As a non-profit 501(c)3 charitable organization, your generosity helps support:

- Education & resources - our ongoing mission to build the single most trusted source of information and education related to this disease.
- Community - organizing in-person and virtual events around the world and an online hub where people can find belonging and connect.
- Advocacy - continued efforts to shape how the medical community approaches research, testing, diagnosis, treatment, and management of IgG4-RD.

##### Donations built the new IgG4ward! Academy 

Gracious donations from individuals and companies are the life-blood to fulfilling our mission. A great example is our new IgG4ward! Academy. It solves a major pain point for patients and caregivers who realize that a rare disease has little to no available information.

About us - IgG4-RD

# History of the Federation

How a group of patients from across Europe came together to advocate for change.

## What Drives Us Forward

The European Federation for IgG4-RD works to improve awareness and understanding across Europe.

By bringing together patients, doctors, and researchers, we create a strong network that shares knowledge and supports better outcomes.

### Our Mission

To improve health outcomes by raising awareness, sharing the newest knowledge and treatment options, and giving patients a collective voice in Europe.

### Our Vision

A Europe where every IgG4-RD patient has access to timely diagnosis, effective treatment, and a supportive community.

## Federation Board & Medical Advisory Board

Our federation is led by a dedicated board of patients from across Europe. Our Medical Advisory Board vets any publication relating to the symptoms, diagnosis, treatment and outlook of the disease.
